content.text: if dependent on heroin or other short-acting opioids, give the first dose when objective signs of moderate opioid withdrawal appear, not less than six hours after the last opioid use; day 1 up to 8 mg/2 mg (in divided doses), day 2 up to 16 mg/4 mg as a single dose; if dependent on methadone or long-acting opioids, induce with buprenorphine monotherapy on days 1 and 2; maintenance is generally 4 mg/1 mg to 24 mg/6 mg per day.
